questions.question: After the victory over Sakas, who among the following adopted the title of "Vikramaditya'?
questions.solution: Chandragupta II adopted the title Vikramaditya (Sun of Prowess) after his final victory over the Saka Western Kshatrapas.

questions.question: Which freedom fighter of British India is widely regarded as the "father of the two-nation theory"?
questions.solution: <u>Syed Ahmed Khan</u> is often regarded as the father of the Two-Nation Theory, arguing that Hindus and Muslims were two distinct nations.

questions.question: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio was a teacher of which college in 1820s?
questions.solution: Hindu college, Calcutta is where Derozio taught. He was the leader of the Young Bengal Movement.

questions.question: Which caves are considered as the oldest surviving rock — cut caves in India dating back to the Maurya period?
questions.solution: <u>Barabar and Nagarjuni caves</u> (Bihar) are the oldest surviving rock-cut caves, dating to the Mauryan period (3rd Century BC).

questions.question: Who among the following succeeded Ghatotkacha, the Gupta ruler?
questions.solution: Chandragupta I succeeded Ghatotkacha and was the first Gupta ruler to adopt the title Maharajadhiraja.
